title: SOFIE · Charging Fleet
description: Wallbox activity, charging transactions and connector evidence.

query.rawSql: SELECT id AS __text,id AS __value FROM wallbox ORDER BY id

options.content:
## SOFIE / CHARGING FLEET
**Fleet behavior, source events, and transaction evidence.** Filter wallboxes above. Blank heatmap cells are unknown; a connector event is a recorded transition, not a continuously measured state.

panels.title: Wallbox activity · power heatmap
panels.description: Average power by selected wallbox in adaptive time bins. No synthetic zeroes or gap filling.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin(CASE WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz > interval '30 days' THEN interval '1 day' WHEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz > interval '2 days' THEN interval '1 hour' ELSE interval '15 minutes' END,ts,'2025-01-01'::timestamptz) AS bucket, wallbox_id,
    AVG(power_kw)::double precision AS avg_kw FROM charger_minute
    WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND wallbox_id IN (${wallbox:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2 LIMIT 8000

SELECT wallbox_id AS "Wallbox",ROUND((SUM(power_kw)/60.0)::numeric,2) AS "Observed kWh" FROM charger_minute WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND wallbox_id IN (${wallbox:sqlstring}) GROUP BY wallbox_id ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Wallbox power traces
panels.description: Measured 15-minute average power. Missing source periods remain gaps.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts,'15m'),wallbox_id AS metric,AVG(power_kw) AS value FROM charger_minute WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND wallbox_id IN (${wallbox:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Simultaneously active chargers
panels.description: Active means measured power above 0.1 kW; no inference from connector status.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts,'15m'),AVG(active)::double precision AS "Active wallboxes" FROM (SELECT ts,COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE power_kw > 0.1) AS active FROM charger_minute WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY ts) s GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Latest wallbox evidence
panels.description: Status timestamps reveal staleness. Power requires a measurement in the selected range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT w.id AS "Wallbox",ROUND(c.power_kw::numeric,2) AS "Power kW",c.ts AS "Power at",COALESCE(e.status,'Unknown') AS "Last status",e.ts AS "Status at",ROUND((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo()-e.ts))/60)::numeric,0) AS "Status age min" FROM wallbox w LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ts,power_kw FROM charger_minute WHERE wallbox_id=w.id AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) c ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT ts,status FROM connector_event WHERE wallbox_id=w.id AND ts <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) e ON TRUE WHERE w.id IN (${wallbox:sqlstring}) ORDER BY w.id

SELECT ts AS "Recorded at",wallbox_id AS "Wallbox",status AS "Status",COALESCE(error_code,'—') AS "Error" FROM connector_event WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND wallbox_id IN (${wallbox:sqlstring}) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Charging transactions
panels.description: Matched source transactions intersecting the selected range. Open sessions use window end for duration.

targets.rawSql: SELECT transaction_id AS "Transaction",wallbox_id AS "Wallbox",start_ts AS "Start",stop_ts AS "Stop",ROUND((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(stop_ts,$__timeTo())-start_ts))/60)::numeric,1) AS "Duration min",COALESCE(stop_reason,'—') AS "Stop reason" FROM charging_session WHERE start_ts <= $__timeTo() AND COALESCE(stop_ts,'infinity'::timestamptz) >= $__timeFrom() AND wallbox_id IN (${wallbox:sqlstring}) ORDER BY start_ts DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Status mix · recorded events
panels.description: Counts of recorded connector transitions, not time spent in each state.

targets.rawSql: SELECT status AS "Status",COUNT(*)::double precision AS "Events" FROM connector_event WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND wallbox_id IN (${wallbox:sqlstring}) GROUP BY status ORDER BY 2 DESC
